<b>Plasmified Blood</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Ten samples of Plasmified Blood are required to complete the <i>[[Advanced Alchemy]]</i> [[wish]], given by [[Alchemist Zylotol]] in the [[Wormways]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Alchemist Zylotol 01.png!Location of Alchemist Zylotol in the Wormways
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Wormways 04.png!Alchemist Zylotol in the Wormways
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Plasmified Blood can be extracted from [[Lifeblood#Mutation|plasmified]] enemies in the Wormways with a fully charged stab from the [[Needle Phial]]. [[Plasmid]]s and [[Plasmidas]]es are instantly killed by the Needle Phial. Stabbing [[Plasmified Zango]] does not instantly kill him, but instead permanently reduces his max HP by 250 (this reduction persists even if [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] leaves the arena and returns). Thus, 4 samples of Plasmified Blood can be extracted from him before he dies.

== Trivia ==
* While Plasmified Blood is typically obtained during the <i>Advanced Alchemy</i> wish, it can also be collected if the <i>[[Alchemist's Assistant]]</i> wish is active in Act 3, as it also grants the Needle Phial. This allows both Plasmified Blood and [[Plasmium]] to be held in the inventory at the same time.
